name: whichllm-hardware-detection-evidence-and-1d4f
instr:
whichllm cannot explain how GPU evidence and uncertainty shape its recommendations. Carry trustworthy field-level evidence from discovery through recommendation and diagnostics, showing what was observed, inferred, simulated, or overridden and how uncertainty affected automatic sizing.

Expose each detected GPU field's source, confidence, and observation kind. Keep failed optional probes visible without inventing values. Keep vendor evidence distinct across NVIDIA (NVML, nvidia-smi, curated inference), AMD (rocm-smi, sysfs, lspci), Intel (PCI, sysfs, curated enrichment), Apple (macOS profiler, wired-limit, Linux device-tree, driver, system memory), and Windows (CIM, adapter memory, registry dedicated memory, inferred vendor, discrete-memory floor).

Group stable device identities during reconciliation and resolve fields deterministically regardless of evidence order. Preserve every disagreement as a structured conflict and retain APU and unified-memory semantics. Never present simulated facts as measurements. Explicit overrides stay authoritative while retaining displaced evidence.

Use conservative uncertain memory for automatic sizing without superseding explicit overrides or user minimums. Rich hardware and ranking presentation, structured JSON, and Markdown diagnostics must convey equivalent concise source, confidence, conflict, and conservative-sizing summaries while keeping established output unchanged without diagnostics, existing JSON fields intact, and Markdown corre
